title: Artemisinin: A Gift from Traditional Chinese Medicine to the World
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: Tu recounts how historical Chinese medical literature informed the research, and dates the team’s identification of artemisinin to November 1972. Her account separates the 1972 plant-extract clinical trial from the first artemisinin clinical trial in 1973 and describes collaboration across teams.
